 HR Process Manager

* Proven experience owning HR process design and HR operations delivery.
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and system configuration.
* Expertise in process mapping, SOP development, and operational governance.
* Experience driving process improvement initiatives and working with automation tools or RPA partners.
* Strong familiarity with Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Ability to define and track HR KPIs and produce actionable HR analytics and dashboards.


**Preferred**
* Certification in Process Improvement (Lean, Six Sigma) or HR systems implementation experience.
* Experience in HR outsourcing, shared services, or consulting engagements.
* Exposure to payroll systems and payroll audit processes.


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Opportunity to shape HR operations and scale processes for fast\-growing client portfolios.
* Collaborative environment with direct exposure to senior HR and business leaders.
* Structured learning and ownership of high\-impact transformation projects.

description:
**HR Manager – Recruitment, Compliance \& Operations** 




**Location:** 
 Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
 



**Who This Role Is For** 




 This role is for an experienced HR professional who can own recruiting coordination, HR compliance, onboarding and offboarding processes, employee feedback programs, and day\-to\-day people operations across multiple departments. This person should be comfortable working closely with department managers, handling first\-round candidate outreach and screening, ensuring company policies align with local labor laws and best practices in India, and communicating workforce insights to leadership in both India and the U.S.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an
 **HR Manager – Recruitment, Compliance \& Operations** 
 to lead core HR functions for our growing organization in Coimbatore. This role will be responsible for managing the employee lifecycle from hiring through offboarding, supporting managers across departments, reviewing and maintaining HR policies for local compliance, and ensuring a professional, organized, and scalable HR operation.
 



 The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, confident in handling recruitment and compliance responsibilities, and capable of building strong relationships with leadership and hiring managers. This role will also own employee survey programs, help surface actionable feedback, and coordinate follow\-through with department leaders based on survey findings.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Recruitment \& Hiring** 



* Manage end\-to\-end coordination of recruitment across multiple departments.
* Conduct first\-round candidate outreach, screening calls, and initial interviews.
* Assess candidate fit based on role requirements, communication skills, professionalism, and alignment with company expectations.
* Coordinate technical and department\-specific interviews with hiring managers.
* Maintain organized candidate pipelines, interview feedback, and hiring status updates.
* Work closely with managers to understand hiring needs, timelines, and role expectations.
* Support job posting creation, candidate communication, scheduling, and offer coordination.



**HR Compliance \& Policy Management** 



* Review, update, and maintain company HR policies to ensure compliance with applicable local laws and regulations in India and Tamil Nadu.
* Evaluate policies related to leave, attendance, employee conduct, onboarding, offboarding, documentation, and workplace practices.
* Recommend updates to ensure policies remain practical, compliant, and aligned with business operations.
* Help ensure HR records, employee documentation, and internal procedures are maintained properly and consistently.
* Partner with leadership to reduce HR and compliance risk through strong process ownership and documentation.



**Onboarding \& Offboarding** 



* Own and manage onboarding processes for new hires across departments.
* Ensure all joining documentation, policy acknowledgements, and required HR steps are completed accurately and on time.
* Coordinate with managers and internal stakeholders to create a smooth onboarding experience.
* Manage offboarding procedures, including documentation, exit coordination, asset tracking support, and process completion.
* Help ensure employee transitions are handled professionally, consistently, and securely.



**Employee Surveys \& Organizational Feedback** 



* Own the planning, administration, and follow\-through of employee survey programs, including monthly pulse surveys and annual company\-wide engagement surveys.
* Ensure survey processes are organized, timely, confidential, and designed to generate actionable feedback.
* Analyze survey results and identify key themes, trends, risks, and opportunities across teams and departments.
* Prepare clear summaries and communicate survey findings, insights, and recommended actions to the
 **President in India** 
 and the
 **CEO in the U.S.**
* Coordinate with department managers to develop and track action items based on survey feedback.
* Help drive accountability for improvements by following up on agreed changes and monitoring progress over time.
* Support leadership in using employee feedback to improve engagement, communication, retention, and team effectiveness.



**Cross\-Department HR Operations** 



* Interface with managers across multiple departments to support hiring, employee matters, and process consistency.
* Act as a key point of contact for operational HR processes and employee lifecycle coordination.
* Build and improve HR workflows that support a growing and structured organization.
* Track HR activities, hiring progress, onboarding status, survey action items, and key administrative requirements.
* Support leadership with practical HR organization, follow\-through, and process discipline.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in HR, recruitment, HR operations, or HR generalist roles.
* Strong experience in recruitment coordination and candidate screening.
* Practical experience reviewing or working with HR policies, leave policies, and compliance\-related HR procedures.
* Experience managing onboarding and offboarding processes.
* Experience administering employee surveys, engagement feedback programs, or similar HR initiatives.
* Strong understanding of employment\-related practices and labor law considerations in India.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively with managers and leadership across different departments.
* Ability to analyze feedback, summarize findings, and communicate recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting a growing company with multiple teams or departments.
* Experience building or improving HR processes and documentation.
* Familiarity with HRIS, applicant tracking systems, survey tools, and standard HR documentation workflows.
* Experience in IT services, managed services, technology, or operationally driven organizations is a plus.



**Key Skills** 



* Recruitment and candidate screening
* HR compliance and policy review
* Onboarding and offboarding management
* Employee survey administration and analysis
* Leave policy and documentation management
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Interview scheduling and hiring workflow management
* Process improvement
* Communication and stakeholder management
* Organization and follow\-through
* Confidentiality and professionalism



**What Success Looks Like** 



* Hiring processes are organized, timely, and well\-coordinated across departments.
* First\-round candidate screening is handled professionally and efficiently.
* Managers receive strong HR support throughout the hiring process.
* Onboarding and offboarding procedures are consistent, complete, and well\-managed.
* HR policies are reviewed regularly and aligned with local legal requirements.
* Leave and employee\-related policies are clearly documented and operationally practical.
* Monthly pulse surveys and annual engagement surveys are executed effectively and turned into actionable improvements.
* Leadership receives clear, useful reporting on employee feedback and organizational themes.
* Department managers are aligned on action items and follow\-through from survey findings.
* HR operations become more structured, scalable, and dependable as the company grows.



**Why Join Us** 



* Opportunity to build and strengthen HR operations in a growing organization.
* High\-ownership role with visibility across multiple departments and leadership teams.
* Meaningful impact on hiring quality, compliance, employee experience, and organizational improvement.
* Chance to work closely with leadership in India and the U.S. and help shape scalable HR practices.

title: Study Analyst
description:
**Summary**
 We are seeking a Study Analyst to provide study level support for Novartis clinical trials, including all aspects of PK data collection, analysis, and reporting, with a focus on non\-compartmental PK data analysis and reporting of PK results. This role requires an understanding of basic PK and statistical concepts and hands\-on experience with use of Phoenix Nonlin for non\-compartmental PK data analysis. Experience contributing to the PK section of clinical study protocols is desirable. Familiarity with other non\-compartmental PK analysis tools and programming languages such as R is a plus. It is critical for the Study Analyst to be aware of and follow internal SOPs and regulatory requirements related to PK data analysis and reporting. Strong verbal and written communication skills and experience with drafting reports of PK results are highly desired.
   

  

 The Study Analyst is expected to work in a matrix team environment with the PKS project representative (PTM) and clinical trial team (CTT) functional representatives, such as programming and data management, and may also be required to attend CTT meetings. Awareness of study timelines and ability to plan prospectively to ensure delivery of analysis datasets and timely delivery of PK results is a key requirement of the role. The ability to independently draft PK analysis plans for the study is desirable. The Study Analyst is considered a subject matter expert in PK data analysis and is expected to contribute toward ensuring that internal SOPs are followed and updated as needed. An innovative mindset with the flexibility to adapt to new tools and methods of analysis is expected.
   

  

 Additional responsibilities may include other trial level PKS support, such as attending regular CTT meetings, QC support for PK analyses and/or regulatory documents, providing input in routine regulatory update submissions, such as IB and safety updates.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Major accountabilities:**
* Provide trial level support for all aspects of PK data collection, analysis and reporting in Novartis clinical trials as part of a matrix team consisting of the PTM and CTT members.
* Draft non\-compartmental PK analysis plans and PK sections of clinical protocol. Perform PK analysis and draft results narrative for inclusion in clinical study reports or other documents.
* As subject matter expert, provide scientific leadership in PK data analysis, including adoption of value\-added innovations, and adherence to internal SOPs.
* Attend CTT meetings to represent PKS and provide study level input as needed. Provide support for QC review of PK analyses or documents.
* Provide input in routine regulatory updates, such as IB and safety updates


**Minimum Requirements**
 B.S / M.S. with relevant experience (minimum 5\+ yrs) in non\-compartmental PK data analysis and reporting, preferably in an industry setting.
   

  

* Proficient in non\-compartmental PK analysis using Phoenix Nonlin. Familiarity with other analysis tools and programming languages is a plus.
* Understanding of basic pharmacokinetic principles, experience working on project teams (preferably global) as well as awareness of regulatory guidance and recent innovations in non\-compartmental PK analysis.
* Understanding of drug development and clinical trials in industry and awareness of key regulatory requirements at each stage of drug development
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Languages**
* English.

 Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people\-and\-culture

title: PM - School Governance (Gujarat)
description:
**Job Title:** 
 PM/SPM, School Governance \- Gujarat
 



**Organisation:** 
 Central Square Foundation
 



**Team:** 
 School Governance
 



**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



  





**About Central Square Foundation:** 




 Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non\-profit philanthropic foundation working to ensure quality school education for all children in India. We are driven by our mission to transform the school education system, focusing on improving children's learning outcomes, especially in low\-income communities.
 



*(Learn more about CSF on our* 
***website***
*)* 




  





**About the Team:** 




 The
 **School Governance** 
 team at Central Square Foundation envisions a transformed school education delivery system that is principally accountable and transparent about its learning outcomes. It targets measuring and publicising the achievement of quality outcomes in public and private schools and establishing a State Schools Standards Authority to enable this reform.
 



  





**The Problem** 




 Despite extensive efforts to increase access to education, learning outcomes have remained alarmingly stagnant in the current educational landscape. Major government initiatives have focused on expanding access and providing input to schools, but their impact on improving educational outcomes has been tenuous, at best. An absence of outcomes\-oriented and evidence\-based governance is aggravated by a regulatory system where the government runs its own schools and regulates all schools, posing a conflict of interest due to the operator being the regulator. Further, there is no way to reliably measure the learning attainment of schools, making it difficult to hold them accountable for results.
 



  





**The Solution** 




 CSF’s Schools Governance team acknowledges the pressing need for a systemic reform in education, which can be solved with a two\-fold approach. The states need to: \-
 


1. Establish a robust and reliable learning outcome indicator at the school level by assessing student competencies through a
 **Competency\-based Census Assessment (CCA)** 
 . This will involve public disclosure of school data, while keeping the student data anonymous, to transparently show every school’s quality and nudge them to make the necessary improvements.



 Create an independent school regulator, the
 **State School Standards Authority (SSSA)** 
 , which will operate outside the current Department of School Education. This body will focus on setting school standards and demand accountability from all schools, government or private.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 CSF is currently seeking a PM/SPM based out of Gandhinagar, Gujarat, to support the implementation of the State School Standards Authority as advised in the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 in the state. The work will involve research of education policy and legislation, engaging with stakeholders from the state educational bodies \- Department of Education, Gujarat Council of Educational Research and Training (GCERT), etc., research of education Acts, and supporting other NEP related efforts in the State. It is a full\-time role, and the PM/SPM would report to the Project Lead of the School Governance team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide technical and strategic support in executing learning outcome assessment related reforms;
* Coordinate meetings, workshops, and consultations with stakeholders to ensure active involvement and feedback from all relevant education sectors in the state;
* Draft policy briefs, reports, and presentations on key findings, recommendations, and progress related to the SSSA, CCA and NEP implementation;
* Document key findings, recommendations, and action plans resulting from research;
* Work with expert teams at CSF on the assigned work streams to contextualise the same for the state;
* Knowledge management and documentation of the implementation of work in the state; and
* Support in execution of relevant NEP related mandates for the State.



  





**Required Qualifications, Skills, and Abilities** 



* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree from a reputed university;
* 2\-6 years of work experience, demonstrating knowledge of research methodology, and experience engaging with government stakeholders;
* A first\-hand understanding of the beliefs and mindsets of parents who send their children to government schools will be an added advantage;
* Fluent in English, Gujarati, and Hindi with excellent reading and writing skills;
* Experience working with state and district\-level governance and institutional structures is preferred;
* Knowledge and experience working on project management, large\-scale program implementation with multiple delivery tracks, and researching and monitoring, among others;
* Strong stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and analytical skills; and
* Familiarity with the
 **education landscape in Gujarat** 
 and regional educational challenges would be beneficial.



  





**Additional Details** 



* Start Date: As soon as possible
* Compensation: Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and depend upon the candidate’s experience levels.

* Entry\-level experience with troubleshooting and providing the support required in network / data center / systems / storage administration and monitoring Services within a medium to large ICT organization.

 Job Details

 ▪ Provide solutions to complex problems on the integration of various technologies.

 ▪ Monitor the environmental conditions of a data center to ensure they are optimum for servers, routers, and other devices.
   

  

 ▪ Lead initiatives for optimization, resiliency, and security hardening of network infrastructure.
   

  

 ▪ Collaborate with operations and OEM vendors to resolve complex network challenges.
   

  

****The Must\-Haves \-****
 ▪ Strong expertise in routing and switching across enterprise and data center networks.
   

  

 ▪ Hands\-on experience with firewalls (Barracuda preferred), ASA/FTD, and advanced perimeter security.
   

  

 ▪ Deep knowledge of Cisco Nexus \& Catalyst switches, Aruba, and Ruckus networking.
   

  

 ▪ Practical experience with BGP and Anycast deployments.
   

  

**▪ Experience With Firewalls, Barracuda Preferred.**
 ▪ Experience of switching on network environment independent of the vendor. Cisco/Aruba/Rukus etc
   

  

 ▪ Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes networking, including Container Network Interfaces (CNIs) such as Cilium or Calico.
   

  

 ▪ Understanding of Meraki Wifi access points along with Z/MX devices for VPN.
   

  

 ▪ Familiarity with Azure cloud networking (AWS/GCP a plus).
   

  

 ▪ Able to work with data teams across to rack/stack/provision and configure to run smooth operations.
   

  

 ▪ Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills in complex network environments.
   

  

 ▪ Proficiency with monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, Grafana, and equivalent.
   

  

 ▪ Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact across technical and non\-technical teams.
   

  

 ▪ Ownership mindset with accountability for uptime and operational excellence.
   

  

 ▪ Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

 ▪ Cisco Certified – CCNP (preferred), CCNA minimum.
   

  

 ▪ Routing \& Switching/IPS/IDS/ASA/FTD firewalls – 4\-5 years.
   

  

 ▪ Practical exposure to containerized environments and CNIs like Cilium or Calico preferred.
   

  

 ▪ Experience designing and operating Anycast networks and configuring BGP in enterprise or data center environments preferred.
   

  

 ▪ Participation in at least 2 successful DR implementations and testing.

title: Associate - Technical Writer
description:
****About This Role****
**About Aladdin Data (AD)**
 Data is at the heart of Aladdin and increasingly the ability to acquire, store, analyse and gain insight from data has become a key component of our competitive advantage. The Aladdin Data (AD) team is responsible for the data ecosystem within BlackRock. Our goal is to build and maintain a leading\-edge Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) that provides highly available, consistent data of the highest quality for all users of the platform, notably investors, operations teams and data scientists.
   

  

 EDP supports four outcomes that, together, enable BlackRock’s data strategy:
   

  

 Provide high quality, reliable data and services to power the core investment processes for Aladdin clients. Enable Aladdin clients to reduce operational overhead and improve client service by offering Aladdin data through a commercial data warehouse, Aladdin Data Cloud (ADC). Allow non\-Aladdin BlackRock teams to focus on value generation, by providing a general\-purpose data warehouse platform. Empower teams across BlackRock to produce data products to monetize their data and analytical models.
   

  

 Members of the AD team get to experience working at one of the most recognized financial companies in the world while being part of a team responsible for designing and building the next generation Enterprise Data platform, designed to automate data acquisition, ingestion, transformation, and distribution to support BlackRock’s and our clients’ data needs. Our product managers and engineers design and build data systems to solve some of the most complex technical and business data challenges in the industry, and they partner with data and analytics experts to deliver high quality analytical and derived data to our consumers.
   

  

****About This Role****
 We are looking for a Technical Writer to help us continue the growth and adoption of EDP (Enterprise Data Platform) by strengthening our internal technical platform documentation. This documentation helps architects ensure that the platform continues to evolve as a cohesive whole, and helps engineers understand the impact that changes in one part of the platform will have on other parts.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with engineering and product stakeholders to ensure that technical documentation remains accurate, consistent, and usable as the platform expands and changes.
   

  

 This role involves creating and enhancing technical documentation as needed, with a strong emphasis on organizing, validating, refining, and maintaining existing content to ensure it remains accurate, relevant, and consistent over time.
   

  

 While the primary focus is internal platform documentation, this role will also support the broader documentation needs of the platform (e.g., technical guides, API documentation, change communication, troubleshooting resources).
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Organize, refine, and extend existing engineering and architecture documentation so it is clear, accessible, and usable for internal engineers and stakeholders.
* Partner with engineering, product, and other SMEs to stay current on upcoming changes, and ensure that technical documentation is updated as part of feature and infrastructure delivery.
* Capture, consolidate, and publish the technical decisions made in architectural reviews, design boards, and similar forums.
* Produce and maintain multi\-layer architectural diagrams, platform overviews, engineering guides, internal API documentation, integration guidance, troubleshooting/FAQ content, and internal release/change notes.
* Document and explain integration points and component boundaries across platform components (interfaces, dependencies, data and event flows, APIs, configuration, and validation/operational steps as appropriate).
* Create and maintain onboarding\-focused documentation that helps new engineers quickly understand the platform, key workflows, terminology, and where to find essential information.
* Gather and incorporate feedback from internal users (engineering, support, platform consumers) to continuously improve clarity, completeness, and usability.


****Required Experience And Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in English, Technical Communication, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly for internal technical audiences.
* Proven ability to partner with engineers, product managers, and SMEs to gather inputs, validate technical accuracy, and translate information into high\-quality documentation.
* Working knowledge of data and related concepts (e.g., data warehousing, distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, controls, analytics) and modern software delivery practices (e.g., Agile, CI/CD, change management), with the ability to understand how documentation fits into and supports the engineering lifecycle in a complex environment.
* Proficiency with technical drawing and documentation tools (e.g., Visio, Confluence, Word, PowerPoint, Miro or similar).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple documentation workstreams while maintaining quality and consistency.


****Our Benefits****
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. title: Business Analyst
description:
About the Role:
 



 This individual will provide backend office support, data analysis \& visualization and reporting assistance to the Business Head. The position involves data collection, report preparation, coordination with sales and field teams, and support in in driving business through analytics in different domains viz sales, competition, mapping, cost benefit analysis, productivity \- derived from system.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Collect data from sales teams, branches, and internal departments for ongoing projects and reports.
* Coordinate with team for timely completion of assignments given by Business Head, taking required reports on or before time, and update Business Head
* Proactively engage with Business Head and team for preparing annual Business plan / sales forecast
* To analyze future business plan (sales, marketing, competition, benchmark, business forecast, future challenges etc.) as part of Strategic Business reviews at Management level.
* Deep analysis of success and failures in adherence to the targets \& to monitor projects \& their progress by tracking status of activities, resolving problems, generating progress reports, recommending actions in consultation with the Business Head
* Analyze investment v/s benefit of various Market development / Marketing Activities undertaken by the company for bringing more focus on time bound results.
* Consolidate data from multiple sources and prepare analytical reports to highlight gaps and progress.
* Coordinate with regional and branch teams for status updates and follow\-ups on ongoing initiatives.
* Help plan and organize meetings, prepare presentations, and record Minutes of Meeting (MoM).
* Maintain trackers, reports, and documentation in a structured manner.
* Support preparation of management presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI.



 .
 ***Key Competencies***



* Working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Sales force, MIS and SAP.
* Proficient in ppt preparation, analytical and reporting skills.
* Good coordination and follow\-up abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet timelines.
* Experience in using Analytics for data\-based decision making
* Opportunity to work with a well\-established brand
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills



  





***Qualifications and Experience***



* **Education
 
 :**
* B. Tech / Management graduate; Master’s degree preferred.
* **Experience
 
 :**
